justifications.r1: Solid Temur ramp with 2-CMC ramp and Doc Samson power-scaling mana.
justifications.r2: Bruce Banner front face provides repeatable card draw {X}{X} dump.
justifications.a1: Typal redundancy and counter synergy (+1/+1 counter doublers).
justifications.a2: Flips into Hulk with counters setup on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents lethal trample damage / Fling burst on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untaps for fair combat, or same-turn Fling / Caltrops extra combat line.
justifications.p3: Board-based combat strategy with visible counter growth.
justifications.i1: Temur countermagic and burn removal (Beast Within, Chaos Warp, Chandra's Ignition).
justifications.i2: Zero proactive restriction or stax effects.
justifications.s1: Protection boots and counter protection; Hulk Enrage punishes direct damage.
justifications.s2: Moderate recovery via counter restocking; vulnerable to mass bounce/exile.
justifications.s3: Front face provides card draw; back face provides finisher.
